description:
Decide how jit records that an issue awaits a decision from a human, so that the wait is visible to queries instead of living in a project progress file.

## Background

Downstream, two issues waiting on an invoker ruling stayed `in_progress`, with the question recorded only in a progress file. `query available`, `query blocked` and `issue status` showed nothing. A profile-declared label namespace was considered and judged too manual and error-prone. Other candidate shapes include a structured blocker record on the issue, a new lifecycle state, and an addressable question item that blocks until resolved. Each touches the domain-agnostic boundary and the lifecycle state machine differently.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A design note compares at least the blocker-record, lifecycle-state and question-item shapes on code added or removed, effect on the lifecycle state machine, domain agnosticism, and the manual steps an agent performs to raise and clear a wait.
- [hard] REQ-02: The note recommends one shape, or no change, with the reasoning, and is linked to this issue.
- [hard] REQ-03: The decision is recorded for the maintainer's ruling before any implementation issue is filed.
title: Decide how an issue records that it awaits a human decision
